floor_history.headline: Recon: floor=9 reconfirmed on pin-free candidate; m2c shows target reconstructs WITHOUT a load-temp (direct inlined stores) and WITHOUT the v1 pointer alias — an untried structural shape; sibling func

Structural sweep (13 forms). Floor held at 9; killed 8 named structural levers; walking-pointer lowers score to 7 but adds an insn so it's architecturally blocked from match — proves the RA tiebreak I
s3 structural sweep lowered pin-free floor 9 -> 6 via mask atomically-first post-call (V7); pre-call proven byte-identical to target so pre-call-freelist hypothesis KILLED.

Permuter reseeded from interleaved-V0 target-shape (fresh basin, not prior s4's V7 seed): no cheat-free sub-6 form; sub-6 finds all coercion-gated (output-30-1 sandbox 5 cheat-reviewer FAIL). Floor ho

s5 directed permuter (PERM_LINESWAP+RANDOMIZE, pre-call frozen): no cheat-free sub-6, but reached sandbox 2 (closest ever) via an invented-var stage that reproduces target's exact load=$v0/mask=$v1 la

frontier.hypothesis: target's layout IS reachable (staging flips it); the true unsolved residual is producing the same RA flip WITH target's forward load order (0x0,0x4,0x8).
frontier.mechanism: The invented-var stage flips load=$v0/mask=$v1 but only when the staged load is the LAST-emitted in reverse order. Forward-order staged forms (11, 8) never flip. The lever needed is a cheat-free structure that flips the RA while keeping the loads in forward order.
frontier.next_probe: Instrumented cc1 .greg/allocno-priority dump comparing the sandbox-2 form (reverse, flipped) vs a forward-order staged form (no flip) to identify WHICH pseudo-ordering property the staging changes, then search for a forward-order C shape (statement geometry / mask liveness) that reproduces that property without an invented carrier.

frontier.hypothesis: A sanctioned carrier (pointer-alias-fake-exception or staged-value-reused-variable via an EXISTING var) could reproduce the flip legitimately.
frontier.mechanism: new_var2 is the flip lever but is an invented cheat. The fn's existing dead locals are type-incompatible (new_var u16, v1 s32*). A legitimate carrier would need to already exist post-call with s32 width, or be a sanctioned pointer alias whose liveness overlaps the loads the way new_var2 does.
frontier.next_probe: Structural/forensic session (out of permuter scope): test whether reusing v1 as an s32-typed carrier under pointer-alias-fake-exception reproduces the flip, and whether it clears cheat-reviewer; if not, the flip is invented-var-only and the frontier is the forward-order reconciliation above.

frontier.hypothesis: Making the MASK pseudo itself the interleaved carrier (rather than a separate staging local) flips the RA in forward order.
frontier.mechanism: Target's flip coincides with the mask lui/ori being materialized interleaved into the load gaps and alive across load 3. A mask-liveness shape that forces GCC to keep the mask in $v1 across all three FORWARD-order loads may be the cheat-free analogue of the staging flip.
frontier.next_probe: Directed permuter constraining only mask materialization/liveness position (PERM_LINESWAP of the mask lui/ori split points) with loads pinned in forward 0,4,8 order and no invented locals.
